raw.name: Informed Consent
raw.description: Obtain written informed consent from participant

raw.name: Randomization
raw.description: Randomization of patient to treatment

raw.name: Admission to CRU
raw.description: Admission to clinical research unit. Admission can be rescheduled if PG level is not 90 to 250 mg/dL on Day 1.

raw.name: Discharge from CRU
raw.description: Discharge from clinical research unit. Patient may be discharged 6 hours after glucagon administration.

raw.name: Medical History
raw.description: Collect medical history

data.name: Collect Pre-existing Conditions and Adverse Events

raw.name: Collect Pre-existing Conditions and Adverse Events
raw.description: Collect pre-existing conditions and adverse events

raw.name: Physical Exam
raw.description: Physical examination. After screening, medical assessment only performed to include medical review and targeted examination, as appropriate.

raw.name: Height and Weight
raw.description: Height and weight measurements. Height is at screening only. Weight on Day 1 will be collected before the start of the procedure to induce hypoglycemia.

raw.name: Collect Hypoglycemic Events
raw.description: Collect hypoglycemic events. Refer to Section 9.5.5.1.

raw.name: Collect Concomitant Medications
raw.description: Collect concomitant medications. Review patients' insulin regimens to confirm acceptability to undergo the procedure to induce hypoglycemia.

raw.name: Meal
raw.description: After completion of all PK sampling, patients will be provided a carbohydrate-rich meal. The investigator will ensure the patient's PG is stable. A prandial insulin dose will be administered if needed.

raw.name: Insulin infusion to Induce Hypoglycemia
raw.description: Insulin infusion to induce hypoglycemia. Procedures in Period 2 will occur at approximately the same time as those in Period 1. Insulin infusion is stopped once bedside PG is <60 mg/dL.

raw.name: Bedside PG Monitoring for Safety
raw.description: Bedside plasma glucose monitoring for safety. Samples will be collected during the hypoglycemia induction procedure and post study treatment (up to 120 mins).

raw.name: Study Treatment Administration
raw.description: Study treatment administration. Once bedside PG reaches <60 mg/dL, the insulin infusion is stopped and approximately 5 minutes later study drug is administered. Indicates Time = 0 min.

raw.name: Injection-Site Assessment
raw.description: Injection-site assessment for IMG only. Collected at pre-hypoglycemia induction and 90 min.

raw.name: Nasal Inspection
raw.description: Nasal inspection for both IMG and LY900018. Collected at pre-hypoglycemia induction and 90 min.

data.name: Vital Signs (Supine Blood Pressure, Pulse Rate, and Body Temperature)

raw.name: Vital Signs (Supine Blood Pressure, Pulse Rate, and Body Temperature)
raw.description: Vital signs including supine blood pressure, pulse rate, and body temperature.

raw.name: Single 12-lead ECG (Local)
raw.description: Single 12-lead ECG performed locally

raw.name: Triplicate 12-lead ECG (Central)
raw.description: Triplicate 12-lead ECG performed centrally at pre-hypoglycemia induction (30 and 15 min prior to insulin infusion), predose, 15, 30, 60, 120, 240 min.

raw.name: Clinical Serology Tests
raw.description: Clinical serology tests. See Appendix 2, Clinical Laboratory Tests, for details.

data.name: Clinical Lab Tests (Hematology, Clinical Chemistry, and Urinalysis)

raw.name: Clinical Lab Tests (Hematology, Clinical Chemistry, and Urinalysis)
raw.description: Clinical laboratory tests including hematology, clinical chemistry, and urinalysis. See Appendix 2 for details.

raw.name: HbA1c
raw.description: Hemoglobin A1c measurement. See Appendix 2, Clinical Laboratory Tests, for details.

data.name: Pregnancy Test (Female patients of childbearing potential only)

raw.name: Pregnancy Test (Female patients of childbearing potential only)
raw.description: Pregnancy test for female patients of childbearing potential only. Serum pregnancy test at screening; urine pregnancy test at every admission period and follow-up visit.

raw.name: FSH (Female patients only)
raw.description: Follicle-stimulating hormone test for female patients only. When needed to confirm postmenopausal status.

raw.name: Ethanol Testing
raw.description: Ethanol testing. Additional tests can be done at the discretion of the investigator.

raw.name: Urine Drug Screen
raw.description: Urine drug screen. Additional tests can be done at the discretion of the investigator.

raw.name: PK (Glucagon)
raw.description: Pharmacokinetic sampling for glucagon. Sampling times are relative to the time of study treatment administration (0 min). Predose time point will be between insulin infusion stop and study treatment.

raw.name: Plasma Glucose for PD
raw.description: Plasma glucose sampling for pharmacodynamics. -5 mins = stop insulin infusion. Sampling times are relative to the time of study treatment administration (0 min).

raw.name: Genetic Sample (Stored)
raw.description: Single sample for pharmacogenetic analysis taken prior to/on Period 1 Day -1.

raw.name: Anti-glucagon Antibodies
raw.description: Anti-glucagon antibody assessment. In the event of drug hypersensitivity reactions, samples will be collected as close to event onset as possible, at event resolution, and 30 days following the event. Patients with TE ADA at follow-up/ED will undergo additional follow-up.

raw.name: Clarke Hypoglycemia Awareness Survey
raw.description: Clarke Hypoglycemia Awareness Survey questionnaire

raw.name: Nasal and Non-nasal Score Questionnaire
raw.description: Nasal and non-nasal score questionnaire. Sampling times are relative to the time of study treatment administration (0 min). Questionnaire will be collected in both LY900018 and IMG treatment groups in both periods.

raw.name: Edinburgh Hypoglycemia Scale: Experimental Hypoglycemia
raw.description: Edinburgh Hypoglycemia Scale for experimental hypoglycemia. Sampling times are relative to the time of study treatment administration (0 min). During hypoglycemia induction will be when PG ≤75 mg/dL.
